packMeta.name: Event Hub (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey event operations command center with 1-tap attendee check-in desk, dietary & accessibility alerts, speaker program, vendor booths, volunteer roster, live budget variance, incident log, and post-event feedback. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 7 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
